answer: Bind attestation weight to a proof-of-work stamp mixed with the previous epoch's beacon, so each seat burns real compute, not just a keypair. A sybil cluster of k keys must mine k distinct stamp chains and keep them live across epochs, or its weight decays to zero, so k clones cost about k times the honest path while earning one vote. Weight is capped by distinct solve roots seen in the last three epochs, so a fleet forked from one root is pruned before quorum. An ocean of cheap keys buys nothing when a walnut shell of compute must be paid, and a willow with no bond snaps at the first slash.
